PITYRIASIS VERSICOLOR (TINEA VERSICOLOR)
Pityriasis Versicolor (Tinea versicolor)
Introduction
Superficial yeast infection of the skin caused by Malassezia furfur species
(normal commensal on the skin)
Common in warm humid climates
Predisposing factors:
- Occlusion of the skin with pomades and greases
- Immune suppression
- Hyperhidrosis
- Heat
